info.name: Liquity Protocol V1 Supply V2 Website Data API

items.docs: Returns an array of yield opportunities for BOLD across DeFi protocols (e.g., Euler, Yearn, Asymmetry). Each entry includes protocol name, asset/vault name, link, weekly APR, total APR range, and TVL.
Returns data on Liquity protocol fork deployments and venues.
Returns a ranked leaderboard of Ethereum addresses by accumulated Liquity points, including rank, address, points earned, and percentage share. Contains up to 1,900+ entries.
Returns average borrow rate comparison per collateral type (WETH, wstETH, rETH) between Liquity V2 and DeFi-wide averages.
